insights.insight: The protocol has cleared $2.5M in cryptographically verified purchase GMV across 35,947 receipts — deterministic proof of transaction, not inferred intent. That volume, accumulated in beta, establishes a live data asset, not a pilot.

Grocery leads receipt volume at ~$61 average basket, but an unresolved 'Unknown' category averages ~$349 per receipt — roughly 5.7x grocery — suggesting a high-ticket segment that category labeling has not yet surfaced for targeting use.

Walmart accounts for 355 of the 14-day receipts, with Costco, Target, Home Depot, and Kroger rounding out the top five — the brand footprint skews heavily toward mass and home-improvement channels, which defines the current addressable audience for brand campaigns.

The 7-day average basket is $56 versus $65 on the 14-day window, indicating that higher-ticket purchases are older in the cohort and recent intake is skewing toward lower-value grocery and dining transactions — a category mix shift, not demand softness.

Receipt ingestion is running at a structural rate of roughly 350–360 receipts per day with no acceleration or decay, giving planners a predictable signal refresh rate for audience sizing and campaign timing.
